parameters.name: R_t
parameters.expression: time-varying; piecewise constant with changes at interventions
parameters.description: Effective reproduction number; modeled as a function of the initial reproduction number and intervention effects.

parameters.name: R_0
parameters.description: Initial reproduction number before interventions took effect.

parameters.name: infection fatality ratio
parameters.expression: population-averaged; adjusted for age structure and contact patterns
parameters.description: Fraction of infections resulting in death.

parameters.name: infection-to-death distribution
parameters.expression: derived from onset-to-symptoms and symptoms-to-death distributions
parameters.description: Delay distribution linking infections to observed deaths.

parameters.name: generation time distribution
parameters.expression: approximated using the serial interval distribution
parameters.description: Distribution weighting the discrete convolution of previous infections in the renewal equation.

parameters.name: serial interval distribution
parameters.expression: used as approximation to generation time distribution
parameters.description: Distribution of time between symptom onset in a primary case and a secondary case.

parameters.name: intervention effects
parameters.expression: country-shared with partial pooling for the last intervention
parameters.description: Covariate effects of governmental interventions on transmission, including lockdown, public events banned, school closure, self isolation, and social distancing encouraged.
